text_simplified: The text describes the behaviour of a child who displays excessive movement and difficulty sitting quietly, along with parental intervention to guide him. It is noted that the child is easily distracted and requires constant redirection.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'بسرعة' means 'quickly', indicating the child becomes distracted rapidly, whereas the English 'easily' suggests the distraction happens with little effort or frequently. The nuance of speed is lost.
